summary: The filing is an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting the replacement of the special servicer for the Westfarms Mortgage Loan, which represents 5.1% of the asset pool of a commercial mortgage-backed securities issuing entity. Greystone Servicing Company LLC was removed and CWCapital Asset Management LLC appointed as successor special servicer under the BMO 2023-5C2 PSA. This is a routine administrative action related to CMBS servicing, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic changes were disclosed.
